name: 18732-imagechat-gemma3-4b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=16, bounded at 3000 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, warmup the first 25% by completion.
workload: Single-turn visual-question chat from `merve/vqav2-small`, split `validation` (21435 rows, flat `image` and `question` columns): one real photograph plus one short question per request, 276 prompt tokens measured, answer pinned to 128 tokens (`max_tokens: 128`, `ignore_eos: true`, `temperature: 0.0`). Rows are consumed in order and never repeat inside a run.
purpose: A photo question-answering assistant on a 4-billion-parameter model, serving 16 concurrent users short image prompts with 128-token replies on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Everything not listed is an engine default, deliberately:
# there is no tuned.yaml and no tunable.yaml.
model: unsloth/gemma-3-4b-it
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Deliberate: a request is 276 prompt tokens plus a pinned 128 out, and the checkpoint's own
# 131072-token window would reserve KV this item never touches.
max-model-len: 2048
